README.md: | **`benchmark/2026-10-01-u8-page-bizzle-appfailed/`** | **#97: page-bizzle `app_failed` in the U8 sweep is a TOOL/harness cold-desktop race at run start, not an app defect. Install OK (`install bundle successfully`, launcher ability present+visible, real PNG icon `res/_X.png`); but all 20 desktop dumps are tile-less (0 `SCBDesktop`, 0 `AppIconCommonView_`) so `select_icon` found nothing → `exact desktop icon absent`. Proof it's a cold desktop: the run's FIRST two keys (page-bizzle 12:20:37, clipboardeditor 12:22:14) failed tile-less; from key #3 (12:22:48) on the desktop had 196–266 tiles and every app clicked. Distinct from frequent-habits/passwordgenerator which captured a POPULATED desktop (700+ tiles) with their own tile genuinely missing. Fix: gate the first icon search on SCBDesktop readiness + classify tile-less dumps as `desktop_not_ready` retry.** |
.octos/KNOWLEDGE-DIGEST.md: - **2026-10-01 #97 U8 sweep「exact desktop icon absent」四 key 分两层(cc-wiki,离线)**:同一 error 串,dump 里分两种根因。① **page-bizzle / clipboardeditor = 工具层冷桌面竞态**:两者是 5cd run 的**头两个 key**(12:20:37 / 12:22:14,run 12:20:27 起、U8 叠加刚应用),20 张 dump 全 tile-less(0 SCBDesktop、0 AppIconCommonView_,只截到 com.ohos.sceneboard WindowScene),而从第 3 个 key(12:22:48 zola-bmi)起桌面 196–266 tiles、全部点到——sceneboard app-grid 还没加载完,bms 就搜图标。install 成功(install bundle successfully、launcher ability 在、真 PNG 图标 res/_X.png),非装包/非图标转换/非运行时,app 没启动也没崩。② **frequent-habits / passwordgenerator = 真缺 tile**:它们截到**满桌面**(700+ tiles、160 SCBDesktop)但自己那块 AppIconCommonView_<pkg>. 不在(另案,疑 launcher 放置/命名空间)。判据:别只看 record.json 的 error,看 dump 的 SCBDesktop/tile 数 + key 在 run 里的时序。修法(工具,非本 lane):首次搜图标前先按 HOME 轮询到 SCBDesktop 就绪、tile-less dump 判 desktop_not_ready 重试而非 app_failed。证据 benchmark/2026-10-01-u8-page-bizzle-appfailed/。
